releaseNotes:
# stable-0.10.0

新增 :
- allow swiping snackbars away
- resolve forum 524 messages through shared server notice repository
- publish timed forum outage notices without replacing update feeds
- attribute chapter comments through explicit references
- add first-line indentation setting
- add default bold and italic settings

修复 :
- resolve catalog jumps after page composition
- bound image prefetch to the reading window
- remove novel forum and immersive mode preference
- load novel details from saved pages and refresh in background
- clear owned caches and report actual storage use
- speed up local readers and content management
- inset reader track beyond window drag region
- reset stabilized progress at measured page starts
- preserve author-only pagination and reject mixed snapshots
- place iOS imports after the package declaration
- cover link errors and retain private message diagnostics
- quote publication summary as a YAML block
- translate partial favorite update notification
- bound quote traversal without caching path-dependent failures
- release scroll ownership while native screens cover the reader
- preserve forum origin port while resolving reference links
- give status bar one scroll owner and inset reader touch track
- import managed Skia resource extension from impl package
- handle optional thread pagination metadata in validation
- isolate native cookies and reject invalid thread snapshots
- restore production reader improvements with Skia resource import
- show newest download requests first
- resume favorite updates without background foreground-service starts
- replace default notification icon with Yamibo lily
- suppress duplicate sign reminder during notification navigation
- apply Yamibo colors to message input states
- prevent post-send refresh from cancelling itself
- keep OpenSpec ignored across older branches
- align scroll bounds and restore image retries
- refresh formhash before new searches
- derive system bar contrast from active screen backgrounds
- prevent competing image page animations
- reject empty homepage successes and invalid caches
- retry text on fresh page before character fallback
- resolve static post targets and novel owners
- make indentation configurable without adding blank lines
- scope thread link context to target
- isolate app identity and local signing config

更改 :
- isolate thread helpers and forum metadata
- consolidate screen content and group cards
- use inline YamiboResult transformations

其他 :
- prepare stable 0.0.10 (11)
- organize GitHub helpers by purpose
- add reusable manual validation and English guide
- archive tests and keep main production-only
- clean up ThreadReaderScreen import
- prepare stable 0.0.9 (10)
- add stable 0.0.9 changelog
- Update branch-naming.md
- prepare stable 0.0.8 (9)
- Update 9.changelog
- Add compact reader catalog search and page navigation
